```{r poster-setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)
here::i_am("Poster_Group36.Rmd")
source(here::here("run_analysis.R"), encoding="UTF-8")
net_value <- function(name) network$summary$value[match(name, network$summary$metric)]
tex_escape <- function(x) {
  replacements <- c("\\"="\\textbackslash{}", "&"="\\&", "%"="\\%",
    "$"="\\$", "#"="\\#", "_"="\\_", "{"="\\{", "}"="\\}",
    "~"="\\textasciitilde{}", "^"="\\textasciicircum{}")
  vapply(strsplit(as.character(x), "", fixed=TRUE), function(chars) {
    m <- match(chars, names(replacements))
    chars[!is.na(m)] <- replacements[m[!is.na(m)]]
    paste(chars, collapse="")
  }, character(1))
}
manifest <- read.csv(here::here("data", "collection_manifest.csv"), colClasses="character", na.strings=c("", "NA"))
mf <- c("original_collection_utc", "original_selection_reason", "original_collection_R_script")
complete_manifest <- all(mf %in% names(manifest)) &&
  all(!is.na(as.matrix(manifest[, mf, drop=FALSE]))) &&
  all(nzchar(trimws(as.matrix(manifest[, mf, drop=FALSE]))))
if (isTRUE(params$final_mode) && (!rq2$row_labels_available || !complete_manifest ||
    !isTRUE(params$group_review_confirmed) || !nzchar(params$repository_url) ||
    grepl("enter all", params$members, fixed=TRUE))) {
  stop("Complete labels, original provenance, member/repo fields and group review before final poster mode.")
}
```

\begin{center}
{\fontsize{26}{30}\selectfont\bfseries Responsibility and verification of AI-generated code}\par
\vspace{3mm}
{\Large Content and reply interactions in five selected Hacker News discussions}\par
\vspace{2mm}
{\large `r tex_escape(params$members)`}\par
{\small `r if (!params$final_mode) "REVIEW DRAFT - verify annotations, collection history and rendered results before submission" else "COMP3020 Social Web Analytics"`}
\end{center}
\vspace{2mm}
\noindent\colorbox{cyan!8}{\parbox{0.975\textwidth}{\vspace{2mm}\large\textbf{Takeaway:} The discussions connect technical checking with human ownership and review. Reply prominence is observable; endorsement, effective verification and stable thematic groups require stronger evidence.\vspace{2mm}}}
\vspace{5mm}

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{0.315\textwidth}
{\Large\bfseries Purpose and data}\par\medskip
How are responsibility and verification discussed, and how are these discussions structured through replies?\par\medskip
\textbf{`r nrow(raw)` raw comments -> `r nrow(comments)` retained comments}\par
`r length(unique(comments$author))` authors; `r nrow(audit$threads)` selected threads. Removed `r sum(audit$removed$dead)` dead and `r sum(audit$removed$deleted)` deleted records. Three threads supply `r round(100*sum(sort(table(comments$thread_id),decreasing=TRUE)[1:3])/nrow(comments),1)`\% of retained comments. This is a bounded corpus, not a representative sample.\par\medskip
\textbf{RQ1: What is discussed?}\par
Word frequencies, transparent non-exclusive lexical indicators and contextual examples. Mentions do not establish endorsement or behaviour.\par
\includegraphics[width=\linewidth,height=6.4cm,keepaspectratio]{outputs/figures/rq1_candidate_mentions.pdf}\par
Examples link author ownership with human review (comments 43861845, 43864090), while 43867077 questions whether additional responsibility could discourage reviewers. Tests can also be mentioned sarcastically (43862230).\par\medskip
\textbf{Research foundation}\par
Observed verification strategies motivate the concepts (Barke et al., 2023); accounts should be distinguished from successful practice (O'Brien, 2025). Our indicators are not validated behavioural measures.\par
\end{minipage}\hfill
\begin{minipage}[t]{0.315\textwidth}
{\Large\bfseries Association and clustering}\par\medskip
\textbf{RQ2: Are specific-practice mentions associated with replies?}\par
Reply rate with specific practice: \textbf{`r round(100*rq2$rates$reply_rate[2],1)`\%}; without: \textbf{`r round(100*rq2$rates$reply_rate[1],1)`\%}. Difference: `r round(rq2$difference_pp,2)` percentage points.\par\smallskip
Yates-corrected chi-square: $\chi^2(1)=`r round(unname(rq2$test$statistic),4)`$, $p=`r round(rq2$test$p.value,4)`$. This is an exploratory independent-comment reference model. Repeated authors/conversations undermine independence; a large p-value does not prove no relationship.\par\smallskip
{\small\textit{`r if (rq2$row_labels_available) "Table recalculated from supplied row labels; coding review still matters." else "Teammate-reported aggregate table; row labels not yet supplied."`}}\par\medskip
\textbf{RQ3: Do meaningful content clusters emerge?}\par
Log TF-IDF, L2 normalisation, cosine dissimilarity and average-link hierarchy. `r clusters$settings$n_clustered` eligible comments; k = 2--8 examined with silhouette and size diagnostics. Selected k = `r clusters$selected_k`, silhouette = `r round(clusters$settings$selected_mean_silhouette,3)`.\par
\includegraphics[width=\linewidth,height=5.3cm,keepaspectratio]{outputs/figures/rq3_diagnostics.pdf}\par
`r if(clusters$settings$used_fallback || clusters$settings$selected_mean_silhouette<0.05) "The primary partition is weak/imbalanced. We do not interpret it as convincing thematic groups." else "Profiles remain exploratory and need contextual checks before substantive naming."` Complete-link and Ward/Euclidean sensitivity checks are reported in the supporting report.\par
\end{minipage}\hfill
\begin{minipage}[t]{0.315\textwidth}
{\Large\bfseries Reply structure and implications}\par\medskip
\textbf{RQ4: Who and what receives replies?}\par
`r net_value("Network authors")` author nodes, `r net_value("Unique directed author pairs")` directed pairs and `r net_value("Matched reply events")` reply events. A->B means A replies to B's comment. Largest weak component: `r net_value("Largest weak component")` authors (`r round(100*net_value("Largest weak component share"),1)`\%).\par
\includegraphics[width=\linewidth,height=7.2cm,keepaspectratio]{outputs/figures/rq4_largest_component.pdf}\par
`r tex_escape(paste(head(network$node_metrics$author,2),collapse=" and "))` lead in-degree (`r paste(head(network$node_metrics$indegree,2),collapse=" and ")`), with different betweenness (`r paste(formatC(head(network$node_metrics$betweenness,2),digits=4,format="f"),collapse=" and ")`). These are structural roles, not expertise or agreement. Reply rates are linked to the receiving comment's cluster; weak clusters limit substantive comparisons.\par\medskip
\textbf{Limits and next steps}\par
Uneven thread sampling, dependent comments, quote/sarcasm ambiguity and network exclusions constrain inference. `r if(!complete_manifest) "Original collection history remains incomplete in this review build." else "Collection provenance is recorded in the accompanying manifest."` Improve sampling and annotation evidence before stronger generalisation.\par\medskip
\textbf{Reproducibility}\par
Frozen data, keyed joins, documented parameters, R scripts and source references accompany the report.\par
{\footnotesize Repository: \texttt{`r if(nzchar(params$repository_url)) tex_escape(params$repository_url) else "ADD REAL REPOSITORY URL"`}}\par
\end{minipage}
